name: Midwestern Gas Transmission Eastern Extension Project

values.EndLocation: Interconnects with Columbia Gulf and East Tennessee, Trousdale County

researcher_notes: Not an existing row. The only Midwestern Gas Transmission row, P0214, is the Portland to Joliet main line (366 km); this is a separate 30.9 mile 16-inch lateral from the Portland Station in Sumner County, Tennessee, to interconnects with Columbia Gulf and East Tennessee in Trousdale County. A Federal Register notice from October 2005 (FERC docket CP05-372, environmental assessment) states 30.9 miles, 16 inches and up to 120,000 Dth per day for Piedmont Natural Gas. The EIA pipeline projects release for August 2026 (sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 505, MidWest 2006 Eastern Extension Project) lists it Completed 2008-04-15, 30.9 miles, 16 inches, 120 MMcf/d, cost 26.27 million dollars. The two sources are independent (FERC and EIA). 30.9 miles is above the 15.5 mile threshold. Status operating rests on the EIA completed date, with no second source for in service. Parent is blank: EIA's current list shows DT Midstream as operator of Midwestern, while P0214 in the tracker names ONEOK, so P0214 ownership may be stale and needs a person's check; Owner left blank until verified. Expansion row shape follows the P2544 convention. No route researched; route type unavailable, a human can trace it from the FERC environmental assessment maps. The Justia copy of the June 2005 notice passed the verifier but could not be read directly (bot wall), so it is not cited.
